seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Ring (player) + beam (arm) move y by 6 carrying on-beam blocks and pushing blocks hit by the beam (push chain); a move is cancelled if any block would leave the colour-4 field.
A4/A3 grow/shrink the beam by 6; a block at the tip (any tag) hooks every fully-on-beam block to follow the tip; an unhooked extend pushes blocks in the swept strip.
Tags: hooked next with only collected on-beam -> collected; off-beam collected reverts. Clicks are no-ops.
Hidden state: HUD bar phase = (n-1)//3 over non-click actions, carried only when the incoming frame matches the last returned one; else rebuilt from the bar.
Unconfirmed: bar phase after unseen resets; hook rule for blocks wider than 4.
